newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanyo Sec up after Nippon Life accepts loan delay.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo Sec up after Nippon Life accepts loan delay.

text.p: Shares of Sanyo Securities Co Ltd climbed on Thursday afternoon after Nippon Life Insurance Co said it had agreed to accept a delay in repayment of subordinated loans by three months.
As of 0455 GMT, the shares of the second-tier brokerage were up nine yen at 153. They earlier renewed their lifetime low of 138.

Thursday was the last day for Sanyo to reach an agreement with nine life insurers on a delay in the repayment 20 billion yen of subordinated loans before it faced a possible mandated restructuring by the Finance Ministry.

"Worries that a last-minute agreement between Sanyo and the nine life insurers may not be reached by the end of the day helped push Sanyo Securities' share price to a record low," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said. "Since the news of Nippon Life's acceptance, buy orders have been increasing."
